As Twenty First Centy Fox INC (FOXA) Valuation Rose, Holder Usa Financial Portformulas Corp Boosted Its Stake Posted by Vivian Park 27 pm
Usa Financial Portformulas Corp increased its stake in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc (FOXA) by 90.2% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Usa Financial Portformulas Corp bought 116,684 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.84% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 246,041 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $12.23M, up from 129,357 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Usa Financial Portformulas Corp who had been investing in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $89.01 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.31% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $48.12. About 4.67 million shares traded. Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc. (NASDAQ:FOXA) has risen 44.38% uptrending. It has outperformed by 44.38% the S&P500.
